The blue object lacks clear definition; it blends into the black plastic with soft, undefined edges, making it unclear if it is a hose, a strap, or a reflection artifact.
The mortar lines on the brick wall to the left show slight waviness and inconsistency in thickness, typical of AI-generated structural textures.
